annotation.interpretation_a: The ACK is triggered after receiving 2 * RMSS bytes of *cumulative* new data since the last ACK.
annotation.interpretation_b: The ACK is triggered after receiving 2 * RMSS bytes of new data in *individual* segments since the last ACK, even if those segments are not contiguous in the stream.
annotation.justification: The phrase '2*RMSS bytes of new data' is open to interpretation. Does it mean the total amount of new data received since the last ACK, or the sum of the sizes of individual segments containing new data? This affects when an ACK is sent.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether '2*RMSS bytes of new data' refers to cumulative data received since the last ACK, or to the total size of new data contained within individual segments since the last ACK.
